name: spaces-context-bridge
description: Single-owner MCP bridge that relays context requests to a ChatGPT worker, deployed to your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:build && npm run smoke

DB.description: D1 database for OAuth clients, tokens and the request queue. Created automatically; the default name is fine.

AGENT_LOGIN_HASH.description: SHA-256 hash of the **agent connection code** (used by Claude and other MCP clients). Run `npm run setup -- --print-hashes` locally to generate the codes and hashes; keep the codes, paste only the hash here.

WORKER_LOGIN_HASH.description: SHA-256 hash of the **ChatGPT worker connection code**. Generated by the same `npm run setup -- --print-hashes` command. It must differ from the agent hash.
